# VegVault Copilot Instructions

This file is a GitHub Copilot compatibility adapter. Use `AGENTS.md` as the universal entry point; canonical guidance lives under `.ai/`.

| Task | Canonical guidance |
| --- | --- |
| Suite routing and producer contracts | `AGENTS.md`, `.ai/suite-architecture.md` |
| R code and visualisation | `.ai/r-coding.md` |
| SQLite assembly and schema | `.ai/database.md` |
| Quarto and website | `.ai/quarto.md` |
| Git and releases | `.ai/git-workflow.md` |
| Debugging | `.ai/debugging.md` |
| Review | `.ai/review-checklist.md` |

Keep `.github/instructions/` and `.github/agents/` as short discovery wrappers. Do not duplicate canonical policy here.
